proposal.reason: Trial 1 used word-only C=0.3 and achieved high accuracy but spam recall 0.0303, indicating majority-class collapse and poor macro_f1. A word+char representation with C=3.0 is a direct next test: character n-grams can capture spam-specific substrings, and lower regularization may reduce underfitting of the minority class.
proposal.review: Only one completed PRIMARY trial is available: single_word_C0.3, macro_f1 0.4984, accuracy 0.8836, class recall [1.0, 0.0303]. No candidate-specific evidence exists for the proposed configuration.
proposal.hypothesis: Word+char features with C=3.0 may improve spam recall relative to word-only C=0.3 by adding character-level spam cues and reducing underfitting of the minority class.
proposal.uncertainty: No direct evidence for this candidate; higher C may overfit ham or fail to change the majority-class behavior. Macro_f1 improvement is not guaranteed.
